shots.content: Inside a living room, a sofa and armchairs surround a low coffee table between a bookcase and the doorway. A woman in an orange shirt sits on the bookcase-side sofa seat and recounts every dance partner from the ball, while a man in a white shirt sits on the doorway-side sofa seat and a woman in a blue shirt sits on the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway side, looking across the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt asks a woman in an orange shirt to stop the breakdown of the ball.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two adjacent sofa seats.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt insists to a man in a white shirt on listing the remaining dance partners.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the coffee table, centered on the seating arrangement, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.
